contract.title: Gate evidence card A_GATE (requires A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11Q, A11H, A12)
contract.invariant: A_GATE resolves only when every required edge authority exists and matches; GateReceiptV1 lists every resolved edge with the exact ready/terminal verdict; the verifier checks edge kind and parsed contract/receipt outcome, never inferring a branch from filenames (§7.5); the next boundary generator stays nondispatchable until this gate receipt exists (§7.4).
approved_files: A_GATE: evidence card; produces $TASK_OUTPUT/GATE_RECEIPT.json only; no source file ownership
interface_changes: GateReceiptV1 for A_GATE (schemaVersion ranking_v3_gate_receipt_v1; taskGraphSha256; prerequisiteReceiptIndexSha256; resolvedConditions[].edgeKind hard|contract_condition|receipt_outcome; verdict ready|blocked|terminal)
security_boundaries: Gate readiness is evidence-only: it never infers branch from filenames; an absent or mismatched edge authority blocks dispatch (fail closed)
Next boundary generator is nondispatchable until this gate receipt exists — prevents meta-dispatch deadlock
overlap_with: FT-G1 (R1.T1 owns the gate tool; A_GATE prerequisites live in the waves covered by FT-A1..FT-I contracts)
contract.instructions: READ-ONLY gate evidence card (execution card owned by the R1.T1 graph tool). Execute: node scripts/ranking-v3-task-graph.mjs verify-ready --graph "$TASK_GRAPH" --node "$GATE_NODE" --receipt-index "$PREREQUISITE_RECEIPT_INDEX" --out "$TASK_OUTPUT/GATE_RECEIPT.json" with $GATE_NODE=A_GATE. §7.6 gate row: unmet precondition = at least one required edge authority absent or mismatched; validating assertion = GateReceiptV1 lists every resolved edge and the exact ready/terminal verdict. Hard requires (conjunctive): A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11Q, A11H, A12. The verifier checks edge kind and parsed contract/receipt outcome; it never infers a branch from filenames. The next boundary generator (per §7.4) is nondispatchable until this gate receipt exists. Focused command targets the future R1.T1 tool test file (plan-specified, unverifiable-at-base); affected command is repo-verified.
